cues.text: Sunlight shines in a blue sky.
Birds fly over the sea as the view pulls back through a window.
A hand picks up a framed photograph beside a vase.
The adventurers pose together. Close-ups show the smiling faces of Marle, Frog, Lucca, Robo, Ayla, and Crono.
The title: Chrono Trigger.
A spiked red shape glows. Dates spin around a clock, across castles, floating islands, and futuristic domes.
A silver aircraft emerges.
Crono clashes swords with a green reptile, then a purple beast.
Ayla runs through a forest and leaps onto a flying pterodactyl.
Lucca fires at surrounding robots. Robo blasts them, and she smiles.
In a stone dungeon, Frog draws his sword.
Under a full moon, Crono practices with a wooden sword, then wipes his brow.
Lucca pauses her work, screwdriver between her teeth, then takes off her glasses.
Marle clutches her glowing pendant. Colorful light ripples around her.
Magus's cape billows against the full moon.
A huge green dinosaur smashes through a wall. Crono, Ayla, and Robo face it.
Crono charges. Robo launches his fist on a chain.
In driving rain, a giant skeleton looms over Crono, Frog and Lucca, electricity crackling around it. Lucca fires.
Crono leaps at a giant serpent. It bursts apart under sword strokes and fire.
The heroes speed through the clouds in their silver aircraft, its engines blazing.
The Chrono Trigger logo appears.
Descriptions by ViddyScribe.
A volcano erupts.
Green reptiles surround Crono among the rocks.
Ayla leaps from a rock, kicking one reptile as she lands.
She clubs another away.
Ayla ducks a lunge and punches the attacker away.
She grins, then sweeps a group of reptiles off their feet with her club.
Crono stares, wide-eyed.
Descriptions by ViddyScribe.
Cliffs rise under dark clouds.
Beside Crono, Frog draws a broad sword, closes his eyes, and raises the blade.
Blue light streams from its tip. Wind whips around Frog.
Golden sparks flicker along the blade.
A beam shoots skyward, opening a swirling gap in the clouds.
Frog brings his shining sword down toward the mountain.
Frog swings toward the mountain as Crono watches.
Rocks fall as a deep cleft opens through the mountain.
Frog puts his sword away.
Crono smiles. Descriptions by ViddyScribe.
